title: Mud Puddle Investments v. City of Siloam Springs (Cloudview Estates Subdivision Plat-Denial Suit)
summary: Mud Puddle Investments sued the City of Siloam Springs, Arkansas after the Planning Commission and Board of Directors both denied a preliminary plat for Cloudview Estates, a 319-lot subdivision near the municipal airport, despite a city staff recommendation to approve it and no stated FAA objection. A group calling itself Save Siloam's Airport has since moved to intervene to defend the denial.
significance: Illustrates the litigation exposure a municipality creates when its land-use body denies a permit against its own staff's recommendation, and shows how third-party stakeholders can inject themselves into permit-denial litigation as intervenors.
